links.outcome: Surgeon-rated appropriateness of LLM answers to guideline-based bariatric surgery questions
links.effect: Appropriate answers: ChatGPT-4 85.7%, Bard 74.3%, Bing 25.7% (P < .001); mean Likert 4.46, 3.89, 3.11.
links.quote: There was a significant difference between the 3 LLMs in the proportion of appropriate answers, with ChatGPT-4 at 85.7%, Bard at 74.3%, and Bing at 25.7% (P < .001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Bing, and Bard) on clinical bariatric surgery question prompts evaluated by bariatric surgeons, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
